quote: We use typical IR evaluation metrics ... mean average precision (MAP) for Core17/Robust04 and normalized discounted cumulative gain at 5 (nDCG@5) for News21. ... we develop a new evaluation framework ... measuring rank-wise score changes (which we call p-MRR)

we perform a round of filtering and use the best performing open-source model from Table (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2) to score each of the generated documents according to the instruction. We then filter the documents according to whether Mistral correctly predicts the generated label
Two expert annotators were asked to modify the TREC instructions ... we manually re-annotating the relevant documents.
guideline: Annotators changed the instructions to make them more specific and then re‑annotated documents for relevance according to the altered instructions.
